content.value_statement: Writing correct database queries across SQL, NoSQL, and ORM tools can be slow and error prone. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code design, optimize, and explain query patterns.
actual_capabilities: Generates SQL examples for filters, joins, aggregations, CTEs, upserts, and pagination.
Creates ORM query patterns for Prisma, TypeORM, SQLAlchemy, Django ORM, Sequelize, and Mongoose.
Builds MongoDB find, lookup, and aggregation pipeline examples.
Explains query flow, index choices, and performance tradeoffs.
Encourages parameterized queries to reduce SQL injection risk.
limitations: It does not connect to databases or validate queries against a live schema.
Generated syntax may need adjustment for database versions and local conventions.
Performance advice still needs testing with real data and query plans.
It does not replace database administration or production change review.

use_cases.title: Create Application Queries
use_cases.description: Turn feature requirements into readable SQL or ORM queries with parameters and selected columns.

use_cases.title: Optimize Slow Reports
use_cases.description: Review joins, filters, pagination, and indexes for reporting queries that need better performance.

use_cases.title: Translate Query Patterns
use_cases.description: Convert between raw SQL, ORM builders, and MongoDB pipelines while preserving query intent.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Query
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a safe read query.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a parameterized query for users created in the last 30 days. Include selected columns and a short explanation.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Aggregation
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a MongoDB aggregation that finds top products by revenue. Explain each pipeline step and needed indexes.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Pagination
prompt_templates.prompt: Optimize this slow SQL query for pagination. Replace offset pagination when useful and explain the tradeoffs: [paste query].

prompt_templates.title: Design Cross-Model Queries
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request across SQL and ORM implementations.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design SQL and ORM versions for a report across users, orders, and products. Include joins, indexes, and safety checks.

output_examples.input: Find active users who placed completed orders this month.
output_examples.output: A joined user and order query, parameter list, selected columns, and an index recommendation for date and status filters.

output_examples.input: Show daily revenue for the last week in PostgreSQL.
output_examples.output: An aggregation approach grouped by day, with notes about date functions, ordering, and realistic test data.

output_examples.input: Convert a user orders query into Prisma and TypeORM styles.
output_examples.output: Two ORM query outlines with relation loading, filter parameters, and guidance about avoiding unnecessary fields.

best_practices: Provide table names, columns, relationships, expected filters, and target database before asking for a query.
Ask for parameterized queries and explain any user-controlled values.
Validate generated queries with realistic data, query plans, and production review before deployment.
anti_patterns: Do not paste credentials, customer records, or full production dumps into prompts.
Do not run generated write queries until they are reviewed and tested in a safe environment.
Do not accept broad SELECT star queries when a small column set is enough.

faq.question: Can this skill run queries against my database?
faq.answer: No. It generates and explains query patterns, but it does not connect to live databases.

faq.question: Does it help prevent SQL injection?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill emphasizes parameterized queries and safe handling of user-controlled values.

faq.question: Which databases are covered?
faq.answer: It covers major SQL databases, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis, Cassandra, and common ORM tools.

faq.question: Can it create ORM queries?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes patterns for Prisma, TypeORM, Sequelize, SQLAlchemy, Django ORM, and Mongoose.

faq.question: Can it optimize existing SQL?
faq.answer: Yes. It can suggest indexes, pagination changes, selected columns, joins, and query structure improvements.

faq.question: Should I share production data?
faq.answer: No. Share schema details and sample values instead of private records or secrets.
